BATTERY_EXCESSIVE_DRAIN.title: Resolve Fast Battery Drain & Optimize Power Usage
BATTERY_EXCESSIVE_DRAIN.summary: Step-by-step diagnostic and remediation plan to isolate battery-draining apps, enable power saving, and calibrate charging limits.

steps.title: Inspect Battery Usage & Top Draining Apps
steps.description: View detailed per-app battery breakdown over the last 24 hours to identify background drain anomalies.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Battery > Battery usage

5.0.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Battery > Usage since last full charge

5.1.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Battery > Usage since last full charge

7.0.target_screen: Settings > Battery & Energy > Detailed Usage Analytics

steps.title: Enable Power Saving Mode
steps.description: Restricts CPU speed to 70%, limits background network usage, and decreases display brightness to conserve power.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Battery > Power saving

5.0.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Battery > Power saving

steps.title: Put Unused Apps into Deep Sleep
steps.description: Prevents rarely-used applications from running in the background, receiving notifications, or draining battery.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Battery > Background usage limits

steps.title: Configure Battery Protection
steps.description: Limits maximum charge level (80% or Adaptive) to prolong battery health lifespan.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Battery > Battery protection

5.0.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Battery > More battery settings > Protect battery (85%)

6.1.target_screen: Settings > Battery > Battery protection (Basic, Adaptive, Maximum 80%)

steps.title: Clear Google Play Services Cache
steps.description: Resolves background sync loops that keep the CPU awake (wakelock battery drain).
steps.target_screen: Settings > Apps > Google Play services > Storage > Clear cache

steps.title: Reset All System Settings
steps.description: Resets system preferences (Wi-Fi, display, sounds, permissions) without erasing personal files or accounts.
steps.target_screen: Settings > General Management > Reset > Reset all settings

steps.title: Factory Data Reset (Last Resort)
steps.description: Completely erases all user data, photos, accounts, and downloaded apps to restore device to factory state.
steps.target_screen: Settings > General Management > Reset > Factory data reset

BATTERY_NOT_CHARGING.title: Troubleshoot Charging Failures & Power Input Issues
BATTERY_NOT_CHARGING.summary: Inspects charging port anomalies, toggles fast charging controllers, clears moisture lockouts, and performs power resets.

steps.title: Inspect USB-C Port & Cable Connection
steps.description: Verify charging cable firmly clicks into port. Check for lint, debris, or moisture detection warnings in notification panel.
steps.target_screen: Hardware Inspection / Notification Panel (Moisture Warning)

steps.title: Toggle Fast Charging & Super Fast Charging
steps.description: Re-initiates USB Power Delivery (PD) handshake by cycling fast charging toggles in Battery settings.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Battery > Charging settings > Fast charging

5.0.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Battery > More battery settings > Fast charging

steps.title: Verify Wireless Power Sharing Is Off
steps.description: Ensures phone is not attempting reverse wireless power transfer, which blocks external charging.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Battery > Wireless power sharing

steps.title: Clear USBSettings System App Cache
steps.description: Flushes temporary USB controller cache that can trigger false 'Moisture detected in USB port' alerts.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Apps > Filter: Show system apps > USBSettings > Storage > Clear cache

steps.title: Perform Hardware Force Restart
steps.description: Press and hold Volume Down + Side (Power) button for 10-15 seconds until Samsung logo appears to reset power IC controller.
steps.target_screen: Hardware Keys: Volume Down + Power Button (10s)

steps.title: Factory Data Reset (Rule Out System Crash)
steps.description: Restores base Android power management firmware if software lockup is preventing battery charge.
steps.target_screen: Settings > General Management > Reset > Factory data reset

DEVICE_OVERHEATING.title: Cool Down Device & Mitigate Overheating
DEVICE_OVERHEATING.summary: Calibrates thermal dissipation, limits processor peak speeds, and prevents intensive background execution.

steps.title: Close Resource-Intensive Apps & Optimize Device
steps.description: Triggers Samsung Device Care memory purge to stop runaway processes consuming CPU cores.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Optimize now

steps.title: Set Processing Speed to Optimized or Light Mode
steps.description: Prioritizes battery life and cooling over peak clock speeds. Light mode significantly reduces heat generation.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Performance profile / Processing speed

5.0.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Processing speed (Optimized / High / Maximum)

6.0.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Performance profile (Standard / Light)

6.1.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Performance profile (Standard / Light)

steps.title: Turn Off Fast Charging While Device Is Hot
steps.description: Reduces thermal load on the battery cell by lowering charging wattage until temperature normalizes.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Battery > Charging settings > Fast charging

steps.title: Boot Device into Safe Mode
steps.description: Restarts device with 3rd-party apps disabled to diagnose whether an installed app causes thermal overload.
steps.target_screen: Hardware Button Sequence / Power Menu > Hold Power Off > Tap Safe Mode

steps.title: Factory Data Reset
steps.description: Erases device storage to eliminate corrupt system state or persistent thermal runaway daemons.
steps.target_screen: Settings > General Management > Reset > Factory data reset

DEVICE_SLOW_PERFORMANCE.title: Free Up Storage Space & Eliminate Performance Stutter
DEVICE_SLOW_PERFORMANCE.summary: Identifies large duplicate files, clears cached application artifacts, and configures RAM Plus virtual memory.

steps.title: Run Device Care Quick Optimization
steps.description: Closes background apps, clears unused memory, and checks for malware in one tap.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Optimize now

steps.title: Check Storage Space & Large Files Breakdown
steps.description: Inspect internal storage usage by category (images, videos, installation files, system cache).
steps.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Storage

steps.title: Empty Samsung Gallery & My Files Trash Bin
steps.description: Permanently clears items in the 30-day recycle bin to reclaim immediate gigabytes of flash storage.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Storage > Recycle bin

steps.title: Adjust RAM Plus (Virtual Memory)
steps.description: Allocates 2GB, 4GB, 6GB, or 8GB of internal storage as virtual memory to maintain smooth app multitasking.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Device Care > Memory > RAM Plus

steps.title: Clear App System Cache via Device Care
steps.description: Cleans temporary data files from heavily-cached social media and browser applications.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Apps > Filter by size > Clear Cache

steps.title: Factory Data Reset
steps.description: Completely restores device storage when system partitions are irrecoverably full.
steps.target_screen: Settings > General Management > Reset > Factory data reset

WIFI_CONNECTION_PROBLEM.title: Diagnose Wi-Fi Disconnections & Network Faults
WIFI_CONNECTION_PROBLEM.summary: Restarts network adapters, isolates Intelligent Wi-Fi switching, and refreshes network stack configuration.

steps.title: Toggle Wi-Fi Connection & Reconnect
steps.description: Disconnects from the active AP, clears cached DHCP leases, and initiates clean 802.11 handshake.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Connections > Wi-Fi

steps.title: Configure Intelligent Wi-Fi Settings
steps.description: Disables aggressive 'Switch to mobile data' when Wi-Fi signal fluctuates temporarily.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Connections > Wi-Fi > Intelligent Wi-Fi

5.0.target_screen: Settings > Connections > Wi-Fi > Advanced > Switch to mobile data

steps.title: Reset Network Settings
steps.description: Flushes all saved Wi-Fi networks, Bluetooth pairings, and APN cellular configs back to standard defaults.
steps.target_screen: Settings > General Management > Reset > Reset network settings

steps.title: Factory Data Reset
steps.description: Reinstalls pristine radio firmware profiles if persistent subsystem crash occurs.
steps.target_screen: Settings > General Management > Reset > Factory data reset

DISPLAY_FLICKERING.title: Resolve Screen Flickering & Display Glitches
DISPLAY_FLICKERING.summary: Calibrates Dynamic AMOLED refresh rate, disables conflicting ambient brightness sensors, and runs hardware diagnostics.

steps.title: Switch Motion Smoothness to Standard (60Hz)
steps.description: Locks refresh rate to 60Hz. Variable 1Hz-120Hz LTPO display switching often causes rapid micro-flickering at low brightness.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Display > Motion smoothness

steps.title: Turn Off Adaptive Brightness
steps.description: Disables light sensor polling loops that rapidly fluctuate screen backlighting under indoor LED light.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Display > Adaptive brightness

steps.title: Turn Off Eye Comfort Shield
steps.description: Removes dynamic amber color tinting temperature shifts that can appear as screen blinking.
steps.target_screen: Settings > Display > Eye comfort shield

steps.title: Run Samsung Members Display Diagnostic
steps.description: Tests Red, Green, and Blue OLED sub-pixels and touch sensor array to detect hardware line defects.
steps.target_screen: Samsung Members > Support > Phone diagnostics > Screen test

steps.title: Boot Device into Safe Mode
steps.description: Isolates screen overlay apps (blue light filter, screen recorder, launcher) that conflict with One UI compositor.
steps.target_screen: Hardware Keys: Power Menu > Long-press Power off > Safe mode

steps.title: Factory Data Reset
steps.description: Full system reset to isolate software graphics driver corruption from physical screen panel failure.
steps.target_screen: Settings > General Management > Reset > Factory data reset
